journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.abstract_en: We explore how feedback shapes, and perpetuates, gender gaps in self-assessments. Participants in our experiment take tests of their ability across different domains. We elicit their beliefs of their performance before and after feedback. We find that, even after the provision of highly informative feedback, gender stereotypes influence posterior beliefs, beyond what a Bayesian model would predict. This is primarily because both men and women update their beliefs more positively in response to good news when it arrives in a more gender congruent domain (i.e. more male-typed domains for men, more female-typed domains for women), fueling persistence in gender gaps.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨反馈如何塑造并延续自我评估中的性别差距。在我们的实验中，参与者接受不同领域的能力测试。我们收集他们在反馈前后对自己表现的信念。我们发现，即使在提供高度信息性反馈之后，性别刻板印象仍会影响后验信念，超出贝叶斯模型的预测。这主要是因为男性和女性在收到好消息时，如果该消息出现在更符合性别刻板印象的领域（即男性更偏向男性化领域，女性更偏向女性化领域），他们的信念更新会更加积极，从而加剧了性别差距的持续存在。

articles.title_en: Motherhood and the Gender Productivity Gap
articles.title_cn: 母职与性别生产率差距
articles.abstract_en: Using Danish matched employer–employee data, I compare the relative pay of men and women to their relative productivity as measured by production function estimation. I find that the gender “productivity gap” is 8%, implying that almost two thirds of the residual gender wage gap is due to productivity differences between men and women. Motherhood plays an important role, yet it also reveals a puzzle: The pay gap for mothers is entirely explained by productivity, whereas the gap for non-mothers is not. In addition, the decoupling of pay and productivity for women without children happens during their prime-child bearing years. These estimates are robust to a variety of specifications for the impact of observables on productivity, and robust to accounting for endogenous sorting of women into less productive firms using a control-function approach. This paper also provides estimates of the productivity gap across industries and occupations, finding the same general patterns for mothers compared to women without children within these subgroups.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用丹麦匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我将男性和女性的相对薪酬与其通过生产函数估计测得的相对生产率进行比较。我发现性别“生产率差距”为8%，这意味着剩余性别工资差距中近三分之二源于男女之间的生产率差异。母职扮演着重要角色，但也揭示了一个谜团：母亲的薪酬差距完全由生产率解释，而无子女女性的薪酬差距则不然。此外，无子女女性的薪酬与生产率脱钩发生在她们的生育黄金期。这些估计对于可观测变量对生产率影响的各种设定均稳健，并且通过控制函数方法考虑女性内生选择进入生产率较低的企业后依然稳健。本文还提供了跨行业和职业的生产率差距估计，发现在这些子群体内，母亲与无子女女性相比呈现出相同的总体模式。

articles.title_en: Can Wealth Buy Health? A Model of Pecuniary and Non-Pecuniary Investments in Health
articles.title_cn: 财富能买到健康吗？健康中金钱与非金钱投资的一个模型
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a life cycle model that features pecuniary and non-pecuniary investments in health in order to rationalize the socioeconomic gradients in health and life expectancy in the United States. Agents accumulate health capital, which affects labor productivity, utility, the distribution of medical spending shocks, and life expectancy. We find that unequal health insurance coverage plays a negligible role in generating the observed gaps in health and longevity. Universal health insurance increases preventive medical spending but not time spent in health promoting activities, as individuals are no longer worried about avoiding high curative medical expenditure shocks due to increased health insurance coverage. Our findings suggest that differences in lifetime income, preferences, and health shocks are the main determinants of inequality in life expectancy.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们开发了一个生命周期模型，该模型包含健康中的金钱和非金钱投资，以合理化美国健康和预期寿命的社会经济梯度。代理人积累健康资本，这影响劳动生产率、效用、医疗支出冲击的分布和预期寿命。我们发现，不平等的健康保险覆盖在产生观察到的健康和长寿差距方面作用甚微。全民健康保险增加了预防性医疗支出，但没有增加用于健康促进活动的时间，因为由于健康保险覆盖的增加，个人不再担心避免高额的治愈性医疗支出冲击。我们的研究结果表明，终身收入、偏好和健康冲击的差异是预期寿命不平等的主要决定因素。

articles.title_en: Uncertainty, Investment and Productivity with Relational Contracts
articles.title_cn: 不确定性、投资与关系契约下的生产率
articles.abstract_en: With relational contracts, increased uncertainty with no change in factor prices is shown to reduce investment in the long run even if the parties are risk-neutral. This contrasts with models based on the impact of financial risk on the cost of capital and on the option value arising from irreversible investment. For the latter, Bloom et al. (Econometrica, 2018) find that a negative first-moment shock, in addition to increased uncertainty, best matches the data. This paper develops a relational contract model to demonstrate the impact of uncertainty on investment, depending on whether investment is general or specific. It then uses a specification calibrated with parameters from Bloom et al. (Econometrica, 2018) to show that this model can generate effects on productivity and investment of the magnitude of the negative aggregate shock in that paper purely with an increase in uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 在关系契约下，即使双方风险中性，要素价格不变时不确定性的增加也会在长期内减少投资。这与基于金融风险对资本成本的影响以及不可逆投资产生的期权价值的模型形成对比。对于后者，Bloom等人（《计量经济学》，2018）发现，除了不确定性增加外，负的一阶矩冲击最能匹配数据。本文开发了一个关系契约模型，以展示不确定性对投资的影响，取决于投资是一般性的还是特定性的。然后，它使用根据Bloom等人（《计量经济学》，2018）的参数校准的规范，表明该模型可以仅通过增加不确定性，就产生该论文中负的总量冲击对生产率和投资的影响幅度。

articles.title_cn: 悲观情绪、分歧与经济波动
articles.abstract_en: The pessimistic bias and the cross-sectional dispersion of households’ subjective beliefs heighten during recessions. We provide empirical evidence for a dominant non-inflationary aggregate demand shock that accounts for the bulk of business-cycle fluctuations not only in real quantities but also in (1) pessimism—to what degree households are more pessimistic than the rational expectation benchmark and (2) disagreement—the cross-sectional dispersion of households’ beliefs. To rationalize the empirical findings, this paper develops a theory of ambiguity-driven business cycles, where the Bayesian formulation of the ambiguity shock can generate positive co-movements across real quantities together with counter-cyclical pessimism and disagreement within the real business-cycle framework. Our theory reproduces the salient features of the business cycles extended with survey data on households’ expectations. Quantitatively, the ambiguity shock alone accounts for a significant fraction of the business-cycle fluctuations in pessimism, disagreement, and real quantities.
articles.abstract_cn: 悲观偏差和家庭主观信念的横截面离散度在经济衰退期间加剧。我们提供了经验证据，表明存在一个占主导地位的非通胀性总需求冲击，它不仅解释了实际数量中大部分商业周期波动，还解释了（1）悲观情绪——家庭比理性预期基准更悲观的程度，以及（2）分歧——家庭信念的横截面离散度。为了合理化实证发现，本文发展了一个模糊性驱动的商业周期理论，其中模糊性冲击的贝叶斯公式可以在实际商业周期框架内产生实际数量的正共同运动，以及逆周期的悲观情绪和分歧。我们的理论再现了扩展了家庭预期调查数据的商业周期的显著特征。定量上，仅模糊性冲击就解释了悲观情绪、分歧和实际数量中商业周期波动的显著部分。

articles.title_en: The Concentration of Personal Wealth in Italy 1995–2016
articles.title_cn: 意大利个人财富集中度（1995-2016）
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the distribution of wealth in Italy between 1995 and 2016 using a novel source of inheritance tax files, combined with surveys and national accounts. We find that the level of wealth concentration is in line with other European countries; however, its time trend appears more in line with the US, showing a significant increase over the period studied. The country exhibits one of the greatest declines in the wealth share of the bottom 50%. The paper also shows that age plays a marginal role in explaining wealth concentration. Changes in savings, instead, are the predominant force behind the increase in wealth inequality, even at the top. Equity prices also account for a large share of wealth growth above the 99th percentile, whereas changes in house prices play only a minor role. Finally, we document the growing concentration of life-time wealth transfers, and their increasingly favorable tax treatment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一种新颖的遗产税文件来源，结合调查和国民账户，估计了1995年至2016年间意大利的财富分配。我们发现财富集中程度与其他欧洲国家一致；然而，其时间趋势似乎更符合美国，在研究期间显示出显著增长。该国是底层50%财富份额下降幅度最大的国家之一。本文还表明，年龄在解释财富集中度方面作用甚微。相反，储蓄变化是财富不平等加剧的主导力量，即使在顶层也是如此。股票价格也解释了99百分位以上财富增长的很大一部分，而房价变化仅起次要作用。最后，我们记录了终身财富转移日益集中及其日益优惠的税收待遇。

articles.title_en: A Theory of Power Structure and Institutional Compatibility: China versus Europe Revisited
articles.title_cn: 权力结构与制度兼容性理论：中国与欧洲再探
articles.abstract_en: To better understand institutional differences across space and time, we propose a two-dimensional framework of the power structure among three players in society: the degree of absolute power of the Ruler over the Elites and the People, and the degree of asymmetry between the latter two in terms of their everyday rights and power. Within this framework, we show that a more absolutist Ruler prefers a more balanced Elite–People relationship. This theory helps in particular to reconcile views on the comparison between imperial China and premodern Europe that would seem contradictory in one-dimensional or two-estate frameworks: the Ruler’s absolute power was weaker in Europe, whereas the Elite–People relationship was more balanced in China. Our approach also helps more generally to interpret specific institutions and other variations in power structures.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了更好地理解跨时空的制度差异，我们提出了一个关于社会中三方参与者权力结构的二维框架：统治者对精英和民众的绝对权力程度，以及精英与民众在日常权利和权力方面的不对称程度。在此框架内，我们表明，更专制的统治者更偏好精英与民众关系更为平衡。这一理论尤其有助于调和关于帝国中国与前现代欧洲比较的观点，这些观点在一维或两阶层框架下看似矛盾：在欧洲，统治者的绝对权力较弱，而在中国，精英与民众关系更为平衡。我们的方法也更普遍地有助于解释特定制度及其他权力结构的变化。

articles.title_en: Judge Bias in Labor Courts and Firm Performance
articles.title_cn: 劳动法院法官偏见与企业绩效
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents the existence of judge-specific differences on granting compensation for wrongful dismissal and shows that their consequences are different for small low-performing firms than for other firms. Pro-worker judge bias reduces job creation for all firms, increases the destruction of permanent jobs in small and low-performing firms but reduces it in large high-performing firms. Pro-worker bias reduces employment and survival for small and low-performing firms but has no significant effects on these outcomes for the other firms. The probability that permanent incumbent workers keep their job in firms judged by a pro-worker judge increases in large and high-performing firms, while it decreases in small, poorly performing firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文记录了法官在裁定不当解雇赔偿时存在个体差异，并表明这些差异对小型低绩效企业的影响与其他企业不同。亲工人法官偏见减少了所有企业的岗位创造，增加了小型和低绩效企业永久性岗位的破坏，但减少了大型高绩效企业的永久性岗位破坏。亲工人偏见降低了小型和低绩效企业的就业和生存率，但对其他企业的这些结果没有显著影响。在由亲工人法官审理的企业中，永久在职员工保住工作的概率在大型和高绩效企业中增加，而在小型和绩效差的企业中减少。

articles.title_en: Preventing Violence in the Most Violent Contexts: Behavioral and Neurophysiological Evidence from El Salvador
articles.title_cn: 在最暴力情境中预防暴力：来自萨尔瓦多的行为与神经生理学证据
articles.abstract_en: Violence and delinquency levels in Central America are among the highest in the world and constrain human capital acquisition. We designed and conducted a randomized experiment in El Salvador to measure the impacts of an after-school program aimed at reducing school violence. The program combines a behavioral intervention with extracurricular activities for 10–16 year old students. We find the program reduced the participants’ violent behavior both inside and outside of school and indirectly improved their attendance, attitudes toward school and learning, and academic outcomes. Using state-of-the-art technology, we measured participant brain activity and show that the intervention fosters emotion regulation, enabling treated adolescents to remain calmer when faced with external stimuli.
articles.abstract_cn: 中美洲的暴力和犯罪率位居世界前列，并制约了人力资本的获取。我们在萨尔瓦多设计并实施了一项随机实验，以评估一项旨在减少校园暴力的课后项目的影响。该项目将行为干预与针对10-16岁学生的课外活动相结合。我们发现该项目减少了参与者在校内外的暴力行为，并间接改善了他们的出勤率、对学校和学习的态度以及学业成绩。利用最先进的技术，我们测量了参与者的大脑活动，并表明该干预措施促进了情绪调节，使接受治疗的青少年在面对外部刺激时能够保持更冷静。

articles.title_en: Trade Disruption, Industrialisation, and the Setting Sun of British Colonial Rule in India
articles.title_cn: 贸易中断、工业化与英属印度殖民统治的落日
articles.abstract_en: Colonial trade prompted the colonies to specialise in primary products. Did this eliminate industrialisation opportunities in the colonies, and did it make them more politically dependent on the coloniser? To answer these questions, we examine the impact of the World War I trade shock on industrial growth and support for the anti-colonial movement in India. We find that districts more exposed to a drop in imports experienced faster industrial growth in 1911–1921, thereafter remaining on a higher level of industrial employment. All evidence points to an increase in Indian productivities as the reason for this, suggesting that liberal trade policies may not have been optimal for colonial India. We also find that districts, which industrialised faster thanks to WWI were more likely to support the Indian National Congress. This is consistent with the view that specialisation in primary products made the colonies more politically dependent on the coloniser.
articles.abstract_cn: 殖民贸易促使殖民地专门从事初级产品生产。这是否消除了殖民地的工业化机会，并使其在政治上更加依赖殖民者？为回答这些问题，我们考察了第一次世界大战贸易冲击对印度工业增长和反殖民运动支持的影响。我们发现，进口下降暴露程度更高的地区在1911-1921年间经历了更快的工业增长，此后工业就业保持在更高水平。所有证据都表明印度生产率的提高是这一现象的原因，这表明自由贸易政策对殖民时期的印度可能并非最优。我们还发现，因一战而更快工业化的地区更有可能支持印度国民大会党。这与初级产品专业化使殖民地在政治上更加依赖殖民者的观点一致。

articles.abstract_en: This paper shows that inattention to taxes generates a time-inconsistency problem in the choice of tax policy, leading to higher taxes in equilibrium. These discretionary tax increases are inefficient as they are deviations from the socially optimal commitment policy. We call these deviations a taxation bias. Combining sufficient statistics and structural approaches, we quantify the magnitude of this policy distortion for the U.S. redistributive tax-transfer system. We find that the taxation bias ranges between 3 and 8 percentage points, alters tax-transfer progressivity, and has significant welfare effects. Overall, our findings shed new light on the implications of inattention and misperceptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，对税收的忽视在税收政策选择中产生时间不一致性问题，导致均衡中的税收更高。这些酌情增税是低效的，因为它们偏离了社会最优的承诺政策。我们将这些偏差称为税收偏差。结合充分统计量和结构方法，我们量化了美国再分配税收转移体系中这种政策扭曲的程度。我们发现税收偏差在3到8个百分点之间，改变了税收转移的累进性，并具有显著的福利效应。总体而言，我们的发现为忽视和误解的影响提供了新的视角。

articles.title_en: The Effect of Social Media on Elections: Evidence from The United States
articles.title_cn: 社交媒体对选举的影响：来自美国的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how social media affects election outcomes in the United States. We use variation in the number of Twitter users across counties induced by early adopters at the 2007 South by Southwest festival, a key event in Twitter’s rise to popularity. We show that this variation is unrelated to observable county characteristics and electoral outcomes before the launch of Twitter. Our results indicate that Twitter lowered the Republican vote share in the 2016 and 2020 presidential elections, but had limited effects on Congressional elections and previous presidential elections. Evidence from survey data, primary elections, and text analysis of millions of tweets suggests that Twitter’s relatively liberal content may have persuaded voters with moderate views to vote against Donald Trump.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究社交媒体如何影响美国的选举结果。我们利用2007年西南偏南音乐节上早期采用者所引发的各县Twitter用户数量差异，该音乐节是Twitter人气上升的关键事件。我们表明，这种差异与Twitter推出前的可观测县特征和选举结果无关。我们的结果表明，Twitter降低了2016年和2020年总统选举中共和党的得票率，但对国会选举和之前的总统选举影响有限。来自调查数据、初选和数百万条推文文本分析的证据表明，Twitter相对自由的内容可能说服了持温和观点的选民投票反对唐纳德·特朗普。
